spec_gaps.description: INV-TOOL-2 ('no tool writes to disk without explicit opt-in') governs every mutating tool per A-002, which names both java_rename and java_apply_code_action. TP-TOOL-0002's plan already recorded that feat-prove-rename's falsifier scopes its sweep to java_rename only, and that feat-prove-code-actions -- the only other candidate owner -- cites only INV-CA-1/INV-CA-2, never apply or disk writes. Re-checked here against the current feature_list.json entry and `node loop/route.mjs --json` (names only INV-CA-1, INV-CA-2 as uncovered): still real. This plan does not add INV-TOOL-2 conditions -- feat-prove-code-actions' falsifier doesn't cite it, and expanding scope beyond a feature's own falsifier is feature-planner's call, not this role's. java_apply_code_action's write-opt-in obligation remains unowned by any prove feature.
